question: She designs bridges. She is an ___.
explanation: An engineer designs and builds things like bridges.

question: He works in a kitchen. He is a ___.
explanation: A cook prepares food.

question: She helps passengers on a plane. She is a ___.
explanation: A flight attendant works on a plane and helps passengers.

question: He drives a large truck. He is a ___.
explanation: A lorry driver drives a large truck.

question: She works with books in a library. She is a ___.
explanation: A librarian works with books in a library.

question: He fixes water pipes. He is a ___.
explanation: A plumber fixes pipes and water systems.

question: She writes programs. She is a ___.
explanation: A computer programmer writes programs for computers.

question: He creates new clothes. He is a ___.
explanation: A fashion designer creates clothes.

question: She helps the dentist. She is a ___.
explanation: A dentist's assistant helps the dentist with patients.

question: He helps a vet with animals. He is a ___.
explanation: A veterinary assistant helps a vet look after animals.

question: She works only in July and August. It is a ___.
explanation: A summer job is work you do during the summer.

question: He works the whole week. His job is ___.
explanation: Full-time means you work the full working week.

question: She works only a few hours a day. Her job is ___.
explanation: Part-time means fewer hours than a full-time job.

question: The job lasts only two months. It is ___.
explanation: Temporary means the job is only for a short time.

question: This job continues for many years. It is ___.
explanation: Permanent means the job is not only for a short time.

question: She stays after her normal hours. She does ___.
explanation: Overtime is extra hours after your normal working time.

question: The company pays her more now. She got a ___.
explanation: A pay rise means your pay becomes higher.

question: The firm needs a new worker. There is a ___.
explanation: A vacancy is an open job at a company.

question: He has no work. He will ___ a job.
explanation: Look for a job means you try to find work.

question: She likes this vacancy. She will ___ the job.
explanation: Apply for a job means you ask the company for that job.

question: Tomorrow the manager will ask her questions. She will ___.
explanation: Have an interview means you meet the employer and answer questions.

question: Before the interview he must ___.
explanation: A CV lists your education and work experience.

question: She got the job. Now she will ___ a contract.
explanation: Sign a contract means you agree to the job in writing.

question: He broke the company rules. He may ___.
explanation: Get fired means the company tells you to leave your job.

question: She works very well. She may ___.
explanation: Get a promotion means you move to a higher position.

question: He is 67 and stops working. He will ___.
explanation: Be retired means you stop working, often because of your age.

question: She lost her job and has no work. She is ___.
explanation: Unemployed means you do not have a job.

question: This job pays a lot. It is ___.
explanation: Well-paid means the pay is high.

question: Every month the workers ___ a salary.
explanation: Earn a salary means you receive money for your work.

question: New workers learn the job. They ___.
explanation: Have training means you learn how to do the job.
